## Brand Strategy
- **"Shop + Savor" framework:** A dual-concept brand narrative.
  - **Shop:** Captures the effortless efficiency of the product offering ("from efficiency").
  - **Savor:** Captures the moments of enjoyment the offering empowers ("to enjoyment").
- This positions Instacart as more than a utility -- bridging functional delivery with lifestyle/enjoyment.

## Logo
- **Symbol + Wordmark lockup:** Used together "for the immediate future" to build recognition and equity in the new symbol.
- **Custom wordmark:** Born from the anatomy of the symbol. Notable design details:
  - Ink traps based on arrow counters
  - Round notches
  - Custom geometry and ligatures
  - Straight terminals referencing ground line
- The wordmark serves as the base of a custom sans-serif typeface.

## Typography
- Custom sans-serif typeface derived from the wordmark anatomy (details on page 13).
- The relationship between wordmark and typeface creates a cohesive typographic system.
